stem: In the minimal group paradigm, a boy could award paired amounts from a matrix (ingroup 7 to 19, outgroup 1 to 25). Choosing ingroup 7 with outgroup 1, rather than ingroup 19 with outgroup 25, best shows an attempt at
options: maximising the joint gain of both groups
maximising the difference in favour of the ingroup
ensuring strict equality between both groups
explanation: Correct option: (C).
